core_rule: A page may not become publication-eligible merely because it is complete, sourced, grammatically different, or has a unique title. It must contain materially distinct knowledge.

relationship_to_other_gates.contract_c: Gate 12 and Contract C (scripts/governance_scaffolding/contract_c_derive.py) are BOTH required. Gate 12 never relaxes a Contract-C denial; Contract C never relaxes a Gate-12 failure. Combined eligibility = Contract-C output AND Gate-12 PASS (see distinctiveness_core.combined_publication_eligibility).
relationship_to_other_gates.ig_governance_policy: The ratified IG route-distinctness authority (main/data/information_gain/ig_governance_policy.json) is unchanged: it still decides route-distinctness classifications without numeric authority. Gate 12's numeric similarity bounds are a separate BLOCK-ONLY corpus-quality gate: a low similarity can never confer a pass on its own (Information Gain and structural distinctiveness must still pass), and Gate 12 never writes an IG classification or posture.
relationship_to_other_gates.gate_11: Translations are evaluated for language integrity by Gate 11. A declared localization inherits its source page's Gate-12 status and cannot create distinctiveness of its own.

text_similarity.method: word 5-gram shingles over the entity-masked substantive body; pages with identical entity-masked bodies are grouped first (hash), then MinHash (120 hashes, 40 bands x 3 rows) LSH proposes candidate pairs between distinct bodies; exact Jaccard and overlap-coefficient confirmation; when distinct bodies <= exhaustive_confirmation_max_representatives every pair of distinct bodies is also confirmed exactly and LSH recall is reported; publication candidates are always compared exhaustively
text_similarity.similarity_definition: S = max(Jaccard, overlap_coefficient) where overlap_coefficient = |A∩B| / min(|A|,|B|) applies only when the smaller shingle set has at least overlap_coefficient_min_shingles members. The overlap coefficient defeats padding (clone + generic text).
text_similarity.entity_masking: The page's own entity phrases (H1 head, title head, route_id, entity slug) are replaced by one slot token before shingling, so entity-name substitution clones compare as identical.
text_similarity.note: Below 0.55 passes ONLY the pairwise textual component. It never passes Gate 12 by itself.

structure.skeleton_definition: ordered tuple of entity-masked, normalized SUBSTANTIVE section headings (H2+); infrastructure sections are excluded
structure.template_rule: FAIL when the skeleton is shared (identically or near-identically) with at least one other page AND (template_sentence_ratio >= structural_template_prose_min OR S >= text_similarity.review_at_or_above). Shared structure alone is permitted.

boilerplate.definition: template_sentence_ratio = share of a page's substantive sentence tokens that belong to entity-masked sentences occurring on at least template_sentence_min_pages pages of the comparison universe

thin_body.note: Pages whose substantive body (after infrastructure exclusion) is below this size cannot carry three knowledge units; they fail as thin.

unit_requirements: page_specific: unit.entity_id equals the page entity_id and every bound evidence record lists that entity in concept_ids

evidence_backed: every evidence_id exists in main/data/evidence, governed=true, test_fixture=false, evidence_review_posture=evidence_verified; a bound claim_id must exist and list the evidence as supporting (or the evidence must name that claim); claim-less units are allowed only for boundary dimensions and only with evidence that is attached to no claim
not_boilerplate: the statement matches no infrastructure pattern and none of its sentences is a template sentence of the comparison universe
not_entity_substitution: the entity-masked statement does not occur on any other page and does not near-match (S >= text_similarity.fail_at_or_above) another registered unit of a different page
useful: dimension is a governed IG dimension and audience_ids are governed audiences (main/data/audience_layer_registry.json)
rendered: the statement is actually present in the page substantive body (3-gram containment >= rendered_min_containment)
distinct: units with an identical (claim_id, evidence set) key count once; a key already owned by another non-localization page does not count (cross-language/undeclared duplicate)

infrastructure_exclusion.purpose: Reusable site infrastructure that may legitimately repeat. Excluded text is measured separately (infra_token_ratio) and never contributes to substantive similarity. Front matter is always excluded.
line_patterns: ^terminology and chemical fact lines that are not yet source-supported
infrastructure_exclusion.anti_gaming_note: Exclusion is by explicitly registered patterns only. Text is NEVER excluded merely because it recurs across many pages — recurrence is exactly what Gate 12 measures.

page_family_map.note: Knowledge-object family derived from page_type_id (markdown) or atlas lane (HTML). The Knowledge Object determines composition; this map only groups the legacy corpus for audit.

verdicts.PASS: all Gate-12 components pass; still requires Contract C + release authorization
verdicts.REVIEW: no blocking failure but at least one component in a review band; NOT publication-eligible until production review records a decision
verdicts.FAIL: at least one blocking component failed; publication/indexation prohibited
verdicts.LOCALIZATION: declared translation; inherits the source page's Gate-12 verdict and requires Gate 11; never independently PASS

legacy_migration.basis: Contract C rule RL / IP-16.2: legacy_public_holding -> (public_noindex, noindex). A page that was publicly deployed before this gate (sealed baseline) may stay REACHABLE while it fails Gate 12, but it may not request indexation.
rules: A page that passes Gate 12 is always allowed.
A page absent from the sealed baseline that fails Gate 12 blocks the deploy (no new low-quality public content, indexable or not).
A baseline page whose substantive body changed and that does not pass Gate 12 blocks the deploy (substantial modification must earn Gate 12).
A baseline page that fails Gate 12 and requests indexation (robots index OR listed in a sitemap) blocks the deploy, unless an authorized, unexpired freeze exception exists.
The baseline may only shrink (hold_ratchet against the base branch). Entries are sealed by count and sha256.
Default (no --legacy-hold): strict mode; every failing indexable page blocks.
indexation_request_signals: URL path listed in a sitemap*.xml of the surface

freeze_exception.meaning: Explicit, time-boxed, owner-authorized deviation from Contract C RL that lets an unchanged indexed legacy surface be redeployed (e.g. an urgent non-content fix). Every run reports it. It cannot admit new or modified pages.

institutional.scope: Non-factual institutional surfaces only: gateway/home, acquisition, newsletter, sources registry explainer, methodology, quality-gate explainer, editorial/governance policies, navigation hubs and maps.
institutional.replaces: ONLY the Information-Gain unit requirement, with a closed singleton function check (one surface per function per language).
does_not_relax: Gate 04 sourcing of any factual statement on the page
Contract C: indexation of a non-factual page still requires R11 (evidence_not_required + claim_not_required + non_factual_class_certified + governed + validated + authorized)
institutional.anti_proliferation: The function vocabulary is closed; a second surface for the same function and language fails as institutional_duplicate_function.
